text: Three fixes to 'athena land --pr', from landing PRs #39 and #40. (1) After the PR merges, rerunning it failed with 'git ls-tree: fatal: not a tree object' until I ran git fetch; it must fetch the merged commit itself before inspecting it. (2) When the job's PR link already exists, rerunning must first ask the host whether the PR merged and confirm the landing from that, even when the job's landed commit is not on the current local branch; today it errors with 'not landed on this branch'. (3) Record merge commits (what the opt-in merge already requests) as the landing shape for pull requests, in the design doc and docs/decisions.md. Evidence: squash-merging #39 broke ancestry, so the next PR conflicted, while a simulated history of two merge-commit landings passes 'athena check --history' with 0 violations. Add tests for (1) and (2).
